I am an old woman of sixty-two, and this small maize plot is rented — not my own land — so I cannot spend too much money on it. Last season I put one small bag of NPK on it and it helped, so I will do the same this year if the cash from my last harvest and my children's small help can cover it. The seed I will buy from the market like my neighbors — the improved kind if the seller has it at a fair price, because in our village people say it gives more cobs. I cannot irrigate — we depend on the rain here in the South East — and I cannot afford to hire plenty labor, only maybe a few days when I need help to clear and ridge the land, because my back is not what it used to be.
